name: Pride
summary: A globe-trotting journey through international pride festivals reveals diverse LGBTQ+ communities and their historical legacies across cultures and continents.

name: Alex Goes Bananas
summary: Alex Nickel (Technicality) was born in 2001. Join him as he discovers, reacts to, and explains pop-culture from the late 1990s and early 2000s.

name: Not Just Bikes
summary: Stories of great urban planning and urban experiences from Amsterdam and the Netherlands. It's not just bikes.

name: Real Life Lore
summary: RealLifeLore explains the history, geography, undercurrents and geopolitics of international disputes both big and small around the globe with the occasional diversions off planet or into 'that seems weird" situations that are quite telling.

previousepisode.name: Why The Taliban Are Begging The US To Come Back

name: Adónis
summary: Without money, without a partner and over 40, Miguel finds himself at a crossroads. However, his charisma and success with older women leads his friends at the health club to convince him to make a living as an escort for older ladies. With them, Miguel learns and enjoys himself, offering attention, joy and plenty of fun in return.

name: Into the Blue: Las maravillas del Triángulo de Coral
summary:
The Coral Triangle is a tropical area located in the Pacific Ocean, where Southeast Asia (China Sea) and Oceania meet. It is the place with the most marine biodiversity of the planet. For two years, the award-winning Spanish underwater cameraman, Álex del Olmo, has travelled around the Coral Triangle, filming the marine fauna and the vast array of coral that inhabits the spectacular reefs of this area, the true lung of our planet.

With a neat 4K image, the 8 episodes of the series cover places such as the Forgotten Islands, Raja Ampat, Komodo, Bali, Triton Bay, Flores, among others, to show in detail dozens of species of fish and crustaceans, captured with macro lenses.

name: Mermaids to Lovers
summary: The young adult rom-com centers on 18-year-old competitive swimmer Trixie, whose home is her father's swimming pool. However, the pool is on the verge of bankruptcy and is therefore rented out to a group of wannabe mermaids, whom Trixie now has to tolerate in her waters. Sixteen-year-old Instagram star and crowd-pleaser Finn is part of this group, and he manages to make Trixie's steely heart beat faster. Will the athlete and the merman be able to admit that they're on the same wavelength?

name: Paper Man
summary: Cha Myung Jo works at a company producing imitation character stickers. Though he's technically the head of his household, at home he's constantly overshadowed by his highly competent wife, who's a judge. However, when Myung-jo comes to create a counterfeit bill so flawless it can't be distinguished from the real thing, he steps into an unexpected world he never imagined.

name: Maiden and Shadow
summary: A-Deng, a lantern bearer who has lost her memory, wanders the mortal world carrying a bronze soul lantern. There, she encounters Xie Jingchen, the General of Dingyuan, who is burdened by a long-standing injustice that has plagued his family. Together, they investigate a series of supernatural mysteries, including the vengeful spirits haunting the Liu Manor and eerie disturbances within frontier military camps. As they unravel these cases, they gradually uncover the long-buried truth behind a devastating war between humans and demons that took place three centuries ago. A-Deng and Ying, whose heart has been consumed by obsession and resentment, are revealed to be twin souls split from the divine spirit of the Creator God. Meanwhile, the Xie family has for generations carried the sacred duty of protecting the soul lantern, while Qin Chong, the empire's powerful Chancellor, is exposed as the hidden leader of the demon clan living among humans. After a thousand years of misunderstanding, Ying and A-Deng finally reconcile. However, Ying sacrifices herself to seal away an ancient evil threatening all realms. In the end, A-Deng and Xie Jingchen restore peace to the empire and set out on a journey across the three realms, carrying fragments of Ying's remaining soul in search of a way to reunite her spirit.

name: Ancient Greece: The Dark Chronicles
summary: Ancient Greece is known as the birthplace of democracy, science, and architecture, but a darker reality hides beyond the shiny marble façade. This five-part series shows another side of Greek history, including menacing gods, oppressive laws, and brutal wars.

name: Игра вслепую
summary: Vocal is a TNT game show in which the stars will have to test their hearing, intuition and ability to recognize the voices of colleagues. The participants are divided into two teams and try to figure out who is singing in front of them now — the real star or her vocal double. The main task of the players is to confuse their rivals and not fall for the tricks of impersonators who can perfectly copy famous voices. Alexey Vorobyov became the host of the project, and among the participants were Philip Kirkorov, Olga Buzova, Klava Coca, Valeria, Irina Dubtsova, Lucy Chebotina, Marina Kravets, Timur Rodriguez and many other stars. In each round, teams earn money for their vocal counterparts — with each game, the stakes get higher and the mistake gets more expensive. The winner is the one who can keep his cool, recognize deception and not let his rivals confuse him.

name: Come Outside
summary: Come Outside is an educational series for children. Auntie Mabel and Pippin the dog explore the world around - on the ground, under the ground and sometimes up in the air, in Auntie's aeroplane.

name: Appleseed XIII
summary: Following World War V, a global-scale conflict fought with non-nuclear weapons that almost halved the earth's population, the city-nation of Olympus stands as a beacon of hope in a world of chaos. The utopian metropolis is governed by Gaia, a vast artificial intelligence, and administered by genetically engineered humanoids known as bioroids. Although Olympus seems like a peaceful city on the surface, racial (human vs. bioroids vs. cyborgs), religious, and political conflicts lurk underneath -threatening to overturn the delicately balanced peace of this so-called utopia.

name: Legacy of Heroes
summary: Armenian soldiers' heroics during Artsakh wars through personal stories, battlefield bravery, and human experiences, highlighting their sacrifices, love, struggles, and how their legacy lives on, underscoring the cost of freedom.

name: Knockers
summary: What happens when straight dudes get picked off the street and get boobed up for cash? Come hang with Jimbo on KNOCKERS!

name: Beautiful Rain
summary: A young daughter supports her father who is diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease.

name: Swaci
summary: The main characters of the series are two pairs of parents of spouses Ania and Mateusz. The young people go on holidays bought last minute and want to leave their 7-year-old daughter, Maja, in the care of their grandparents. As a result of a mistake, both Ania's parents from the countryside and Mateusz's parents, who live in the big city, come to look after their granddaughter.

name: No.99,Happiness Road
summary: Told through the eyes of Su Man, a young woman from Taipei, China, this warm, uplifting, and lightly comedic series follows her unexpected journey. Unemployed and broke after her ex-boyfriend empties their joint savings, Su Man travels to Lucheng to demand repayment. Instead, she ends up with a restaurant, all that's left of the debt. Selling it isn't easy, so her actuary logic kicks in: run the business, raise its value, then sell. On the other side of town, Chen Yu, a Michelin chef chasing the essence of great food, returns to Lucheng and stumbles into Su Man's life through that very storefront. Together, they start an unlikely partnership running a cozy neighborhood eatery at No. 99 Xingfu Road. They whip up comforting dishes for the city's tireless workers. Through cooking and keeping each other company day by day, they go from clash to connection, from going it alone to leaning on each other. As the street fills with savory smells and laughter, the old neighborhood regains its pulse. In this simple yet profound journey, both find the flavor of happiness once again.

name: Trial of Healer
summary: A miracle doctor whose entire family was slaughtered, Yang Yunfan returns with amnesia and storms into Qijiang City as a dark horse, only to be swept into the power struggles of the Xuan Medical Association's rival families. Entangled with a domineering CEO, Ye Qingxue, a gentle and delicate pharmacist, Lu Tanxiang, and a beautiful assassin, Lin Hongxiu, can he unravel the mystery of his own past?

name: The Underworld
summary: As Shicheng City rises with the logistics boom, gang violence spreads across the city. Undercover officer Ling Che is forced to partner with street hustler Shen Yanlin. What begins as a clash of enemies slowly turns into an unbreakable bond. But as they dig deeper, betrayal emerges from within and corruption runs through the police force. When loyalty becomes a weapon and justice becomes a bargaining chip, a deadly battle between right and wrong is about to unfold...

name: Inherently Kind
summary: While investigating Meiyan International's raw material fraud, Su Li's involved in an accident and wakes up with amnesia. Mistaken for Gu Qingmei, the He family's meek daughter-in-law who happens to look exactly like her, she's swept into a world of wealth and secrets. Teaming up with Mu Shaoze, who's seeking revenge, they dig deeper and uncover a conspiracy bigger than they ever imagined.

name: Million Dollar Nannies
summary: The series follows a young group of elite nannies, who head to Ibiza to launch a new kind of agency, built by nannies, for nannies. They're promised VIP families, life-changing money and a shot at something bigger than any of them could build alone. But fierce competition, personal drama and a scandal from the past threaten to derail the dream before the summer sets.

name: Mister Miracle
summary: Scott Free is the world's greatest escape artist, known to the world as Mister Miracle, whose perfect life with his warrior wife Big Barda falls apart when their two home worlds — Apocalypse and New Genesis — go to war and Scott's cruel adoptive father Darkseid appears to have captured the ultimate weapon, the Anti-Life Equation, that will give him total dominance over the universe.

name: Sortez-moi de moi
summary: Also on Crave and Prime Video, mini-series, only one season

name: Unfold
summary: Bai Che, a death-scene cleanup worker, discovers his adoptive father's mysterious death at a job site. Black-market organ trade messages soon appear, and a break-in at his home makes him realize he is also in danger. Zhou Chen, who claims to be an organ donation coordinator, comes to him and begins uncovering the dark truth behind organ trafficking, gang forces, and hidden secrets about Bai Che's identity. As the mastermind behind the case closes in, the two men can only rely on each other through betrayal and pursuit.

name: Familiegeheimen: Het ware gelaat van Joris
Couple or Not
summary: Depicts the story of Gui Ming, a young man who found himself in a parallel world as an Omega in the ABO world. Not only married to his Alpha's arch-enemy but... also conceived his child? Since then, Gui Ming's life began, and the tug-of-war of love during the ten months of pregnancy began...

name: Setting the Tempo
summary: Setting the Tempo takes audiences inside the exhilarating, high-stakes process of building a WNBA franchise from the ground up. Led by an all-women leadership team featuring head coach Sandy Brondello, a two-time WNBA champion and the 2014 WNBA Coach of the Year, and general manager Monica Wright Rogers, a two-time WNBA champion, the series captures the relentless race against the clock as they evaluate talent, establish a culture, and lay the foundation for sustained success.

name: The Accused: Beyond Reasonable Doubt?
summary: True crime stories of people fighting convictions they claim are a miscarriage of justice - some after years in prison. Can they overturn their guilty verdict?

name: Martha and Friends
summary: 10-year-old Martha Stewart and her friends learn how to make the holidays special with Martha's unique brand of do-it-yourself magic.

name: Not yours
summary:
To repay his father's debt, Pao Bei is forced to work at the mansion of the cold and wealthy P'Eng. Bound by a contract, the two go from mutual dislike to becoming increasingly drawn to each other. When a stolen diamond ring exposes dark secrets within P'Eng's powerful family, the wounds hidden beneath his icy exterior gradually come to light. Meanwhile, Pao Bei's best friend Jiang Weibang unexpectedly reunites with his former rival Li Milan, who is now a popular celebrity. They immediately fall back into their old habit of trading barbs, only to find themselves attracted to each other all over again. Two couples, two fated romances—from bitter rivalry to love completely out of control!

A new adaptation of the best-selling novel by ""Cutie Pie"" author BamBam.

name: The Insipid Prince's Furtive Grab for The Throne
summary: A low-ranking prince scorned as incompetent. His true identity is—the seventh prince of the powerful Ardrasia Empire. Arnold, the seventh prince of this empire, was known as the "Dust-Drained Prince" because his twin brother, Leonard, was so talented that he had sucked everything out of him. In the midst of the intensifying struggle for the throne following the sudden death of the first prince, who was the crown prince, Arnold decides to get serious, thinking, "I don't want to die, so I'll just make my brother emperor." While playing the role of the incompetent "Dust-Drained Prince" on the public stage, he secretly operates with overwhelming power as "Silver," one of only five SS-rank adventurers on the continent, and controls the struggle for the throne from the shadows.

name: The Oblivious Saint Can't Contain Her Power
summary: Carolina, overshadowed by her prime minister father and mage sister, accepts her quiet fate, but a royal decree forces her into marriage with a fearsome prince. Amid political danger, she discovers true love and her own hidden power.

name: Американский жених
summary: The main characters of the show "American Groom" are four adult, successful men who are looking for brides. They are Americans of Russian descent, whose families left for the States before the collapse of the USSR. The heroes believe that spoiled, materialistic American women are not suitable as faithful wives, so they move into a luxurious villa in Miami, where they are joined by Russian girls - brides for American grooms. Only sincere feelings can lead the participants to marriage. Each of them has her own story, full of disappointments, failures and mistakes in finding the man of her life. True love, home, family - this is why the girls came to the project "American Groom". Every week, one of them is forced to leave the project, and her place is instantly taken by a new participant. In the finale, the grooms introduce their chosen ones to their parents and make their final decision—to marry the Russian beauty or send her home. The show's host is the world's most famous, curvy Russian model, Katya Zharkova.

name: Melty Lancer
summary: When a giant robot invades 22nd-century Earth and threatens to destroy humanity, only a special unit of security immigration officers can stop it.

name: Château DIY: Australia
summary: Intrepid Australians breathe new life into unloved chateaux in France, transforming these breathtaking buildings into dream homes, thriving businesses and family legacies, halfway around the world

name: Ban Chok Dee
summary: Ban Chok Dee is a large, isolated rental house in a remote suburb. The main post of the house was made from a teak tree, which is possessed by a spirit of a nymph. Almost every house usually has one. The wood used to build it also has a ghost. The mystery or origin of each piece of wood tells the story of various people's lives that have been involved in this house. When good people come, the ghost will provide help and protection. But if they are bad, the ghost will harm them. It teaches that doing good deeds brings good results and doing evil things brings bad results.

name: Icebreaker
summary: Icebreaker follows Anastasia Allen, a competitive figure skater with her eyes on Olympic gold. Everything changes when Anastasia is forced to share the rink with Nate Hawkins, a hockey player who's equally determined to go pro. Despite the cold temperatures on the ice, the heat between Anastasia and Nate is undeniable. Is ambition or attraction the sharper blade?

name: Summer Game Fest
summary: The video game industry's premier annual digital showcase and hype campaign.

name: Rick Stein's Tastes of the World
summary: Rick Stein takes us on a culinary journey with this collection, unearthing some hidden gems for all to enjoy.

name: Kings of Coke: New Blood
summary: Kings of Coke: New Blood takes audiences into a ruthless biker gang war in the drug trade sparking a deadly underworld power struggle involving the mafia, the West End Gang, and rival crews. As violence spreads, investigators trace the money to a mysterious kingpin known only as Beef. Leading to the takedown of powerful leaders and their massive criminal empires.

name: Doc
summary: He's a genius doctor, until a bullet turns him into a patient. Now, it's up to his team of colleagues to help him recover the last years of his life.

name: Nord Sud Ovest Est - La leggendaria storia degli 883
summary: Max and Mauro's story continues. After "Hanno Ucciso l'Uomo Ragno", Nord Sud Ovest Est - La legendaria storia degli 883 shows the events that led to the second album of the band from Pavia, which reached the height of overwhelming success.

name: Consultant Shi o shippitsu suru otoko
summary: A budding novelist realizes his crime fiction is being used as a blueprint for real-life assassinations by a mysterious organization.

name: Murder 101
summary: In a quiet Tennessee town, a high school sociology class takes on a mystery that has lingered for decades. Led by teacher Alex Campbell, the students of Elizabethton High School begin investigating the Redhead Murders—a series of unsolved killings that once captured headlines across the South before fading from public memory. What starts as a classroom project soon evolves into a remarkable real-world investigation, as the students uncover new leads, connect long-overlooked clues, and bring fresh attention to victims who were nearly forgotten. Along the way, they discover that the search for answers is about more than solving a case—it's about giving a voice to the people at the center of it and proving that determination can come from the most unexpected places.

name: Submarine Jim
summary: Young dolphin Jim is tasked with steering the world's first submarine on wheels.

name: The 50
summary: For the first time, the Lion opens the doors of his castle to fifty players, the most famous faces from television and the world of social media. Completely unaware, they'll confront old grudges, form new relationships, and above all, compete in the arena: the winner chooses which of the losers to eliminate. Only one will triumph, winning the prize money for one of their followers. This is The 50!

name: D&D: Dungeon Masters
summary: Dungeon Masters is a new storytelling experience from D&D where you can play along with the action. In each episode, you'll experience a bold new presentation of D&D storytelling with an original score by five-time Grammy-nominated composer David Arkenstone, a custom set, cinematic presentation, and elevated production design, all built from material players can actually bring home and make their own.

name: Homestead Rescue: Intervention
summary: Wilderness experts confront people living on the edge of survival to make them choose between a professional rescue and continuing to live under dangerous conditions.

name: Head Girl
summary: Three Wellington flatmates try to figure out life in their 20s - Flo wants to be a poet, Dee wants to have a good time, and Sadie wants to be perfect. But they seem to be getting in each other's way.

name: Janosik
summary: Janosik - a robber captain like his legendary Slovak role model - lives at a time when the underground rumble of the bourgeois revolution can already be heard on the European continent. The life of the often downtrodden peasants in Poland has become unbearable, and not everyone is willing to accept their fate willingly. In their distress, they not only turn to Janosik to ask for help from the robbers, but quite a few join the gang. After all, the robbers try to realize their ideas of law and justice on their own. They help the poor because they are poor themselves. And so they, witty and courageous fellows as they are, trick the gentlemen quite a few times.

name: Whale Star: The Gyeongseong Mermaid
summary: Set in 1926 Gyeongseong during Japanese occupation that follows the story of Kang Ui Hyeon, a man who dedicates everything to his country, and Su A, a woman who risks her life to protect him. A Korean reimaging of Hans Christian Andersen's "The Little Mermaid."

name: The Pinnacle
summary: Set in the cutthroat world of New York City real estate, The Pinnacle is the story of ambitious and streetsmart Charlie Mahoney, who is catapulted to the heart of the billionaire Van Buren family and their dazzling penthouse on New York's Billionaire's Row after becoming the sobriety companion to their troubled son, Theo. As he gains their trust and acclimates to their sumptuous lifestyle, Charlie must navigate scheming staff, suspicious friends and romantic entanglements while hiding a secret of his own and securing his permanent place in New York's ultra wealthy circles.

name: The Silver Theatre
summary: The Silver Theatre is a live dramatic anthology series that aired on the CBS television network from 1949 to 1950. Rather than having a single overarching narrative, it featured stand-alone episodes focusing on the humorous, silly, frustrating, and rewarding aspects of romance. Each 30-minute episode starred a different rotating cast of prominent Hollywood actors and was sponsored by the International Silver Company.

name: King & Prince: Our Meet-Up in LA
summary: Through thick and thin, Ren Nagase and Kaito Takahashi of King & Prince have always been by each other's side. In Los Angeles, a city full of personal memories for them, the duo set out to celebrate their bond through a uniquely themed adventure. Once inseparable, Ren and Kaito must now part ways to complete a series of challenges before finding their way back to each other. As they navigate the city on their own, the distance reveals new perspectives and deeper feelings. This is the real Ren and Kaito, off-duty and offstage. Join them on their heartfelt journey across the United States and experience the simple joy of finally meeting up again.

name: Après OD Chypre
summary: A few months after *OD Chypre*, the contestants look back on the adventure that changed their lives. Amid shocking revelations, tears, breakups, friendships, and new beginnings, they open up like never before. Through an intimate look at their daily lives, we finally discover what lies behind *Après OD Chypre*.

name: Şule
summary: Combining two innovative perspectives – "time within time" and "series within series" – the series tells the story of Leyla, a 28-year-old young and beautiful actress who rapidly climbs the ladder of fame by playing the role assigned to her by the system, but who, under the light of Şule Yüksel Şenler's guidance, discovers her true role and tries to forge her own path.

name: De Eetclub
summary: When Karen moves with her family to Bergen, they are warmly welcomed into the dinner club, a seductive group of friends who fully indulge in an extravagant and hedonistic lifestyle. Until one of the luxurious villas goes up in flames, and their friend Evert is killed. His wife and children barely survive. Karen soon discovers that their close friendship is held together by lies. Everyone has something to hide. Nothing is what it seems. So Karen sets out in search of the truth, but at what cost?

name: He Gui Mi De Liao Tian Ji Lu Gong Kai Le
Don't Mess with the Country Girl
summary: Tu Mingyue was born into a wealthy family, but after her father passed away when she was eight, her uncle seized the family fortune and home. She grew up in the countryside with her grandfather. Years later, when her grandfather suffers a heart attack and urgently needs expensive treatment, her uncle offers to cover the medical costs on one condition. She must return to the city and marry Gu Ziyan, her cousin Tu Yanxin's disabled fiancé, in her place. What no one tells her is that Gu Ziyan is actually the mysterious president of the Gu Group and Yancheng's richest man...

name: Pompeii: Out of Time with Tom Hiddleston
summary:
A historical exploration about the eruption of Vesuvius in 79 A.D. and the preserved Roman city it left behind.

Tom Hiddleston asks: Could anyone survive Pompeii's final day? Drawing on experts and intuition, he traces real Romans through the eruption.

name: Da Hun Dang Ri，Wo Xian Ru Le Xun Huan
ComicView: Rooftop Series
summary: Each episode spotlights three of the funniest comics delivering sharp, unfiltered takes on culture, family, and real life—from a Hollywood rooftop. The result is a charged, anything-can-happen atmosphere of crowd interactions, celebrity drop-ins, and organic viral moments: a throwback with a fresh point of view, elevating the next wave of comedic voices under the lights of Hollywood.

previousepisode.name: Sydney Castillo, Kalea McNeil, Tony Roberts

name: Raakh
summary: Raakh is a haunting crime investigation that begins with the disappearance and murder of two teenagers in Delhi. Set in 1978, when such brutality was rare and shocking, the series follows the relentless manhunt launched to track down the killers while exploring the disturbing psyche of the men behind the crime.

name: No.1 Student
summary: After class placements were decided, the school's two infamous "problem youth" shared not only the same class but the same desk. They're clearly good at studies but pretend to be slackers. Fakers from head to toe, they just keep walking farther down the path of their performance.

name: Still Holding Up Like The Moon
summary: Duean Daranphob was called "The Eternal Moon", a young actor who took his own life at just twenty-five. Forty years have passed, but his presence still lingers in the heart of Thai entertainment.

name: 30 Days of Us
summary: When Bear and Cho's relationship reached a point of saturation and distance, they agreed to a 30-day period to reflect on their feelings and their future. Sharing memories and talking through their emotional rifts, will the two of them decide to stay together or separate for good?

name: Dara-san of Reiwa
summary: When two curious siblings venture into a forbidden, cursed mountain forest in search of local legend, they unexpectedly stumble upon Dara-san—a terrifying, half-human, half-snake demon. Instead of devouring them, the ancient spirit takes them in for a sleepover, kicking off a supernatural comedy about an unknowable horror adapting to everyday domestic life.

name: Goodbye, Lara
summary: A banished mermaid princess, who dissolved into bubbles after a failed forbidden romance with a human, is reborn in modern-day Japan. Teaming up with a high school boxer, she must navigate human society and successfully find true love to complete her second chance at life.

name: Grow Up Show -Sunflower Circus-
summary: Set in 1950s Japan, Grow Up Show follows a group of cheerful yet resilient girls who belong to a wandering circus troupe struggling to survive financially. As they travel from town to town, performing under harsh conditions, the girls confront reality, responsibility, and personal growth—learning what it truly means to grow up while chasing dreams beneath the circus tent.

name: Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life
summary: Reincarnated into modern Japan, a lazy former demon king trying to live a quiet life as a NEET gamer finds his peace shattered when the hero who defeated him—now a high school girl—tracks him down to resume their battle, forcing them into an unexpected romance.

name: Heroine? Saint? No, I'm an All-Works Maid (And Proud of It)!
summary: Chosen by prophecy to be the kingdom's holy savior, a defiant heroine takes a job as an all-works maid instead, forcing a bewildered crown prince to court a servant who is far more interested in perfect laundry than saving the world.

name: Kaiju Girl Caramelise
summary: A shy, ostracized high school girl with a rare, mysterious illness must navigate her first crush on the class idol while trying to keep her massive, terrifying secret under wraps: anytime she gets romantically worked up or embarrassed, her body transforms into a giant, destructive kaiju.

previousepisode.name: Charge This One Strike With Love

name: Love Unseen Beneath the Clear Night Sky
summary: An introverted, disillusioned university student finds his life transformed after meeting an optimistic blind woman. As they bond over fulfilling her bucket list—including a dream to see fireworks—they must navigate a bittersweet romance cut short by the return of her childhood illness.

name: Mebius Dust
summary: When a meteorite shower strikes Earth releasing miracle-granting dust, it accelerates economic disparity and triggers violent terrorism. Amidst the chaos, three high schoolers navigate their seemingly normal downtown lives... while training for a specialized anti-terrorist squad.

name: Rich Girl Caretaker: I'm Secretly the Caregiver of the Most Popular Girl in This Rich Kid School
summary: A normal, struggling high school boy gets swept up in a kidnapping plot involving a billionaire's daughter. He is subsequently hired as her live-in caretaker. While she must project the image of a flawless, brilliant student at school, he must secretly manage her completely hopeless daily life at home.

previousepisode.name: It's full of unattainable, beautiful women.

name: The Duke's Son Claims He Won't Love Me Yet Showers Me with Adoration
summary: An arranged marriage. Two complete strangers. One adorable romance! When cheerful noblewoman Elsa is suddenly wed to the reserved duke-to-be Julius, neither expects their political marriage to spark something more. As awkward misunderstandings, sweet gestures, and growing feelings pile up, these newlyweds discover that falling in love might be the easiest—and hardest—part of married life.

previousepisode.name: A Promise on the Night of Falling Stars

name: The Ogre's Bride
summary: In a world where humans and ayakashi–supernatural beings–coexist, being chosen as an ayakashi's bride is the ultimate honor. Yuzu, an ordinary schoolgirl, has been overlooked her whole life, eclipsed by the shadow of her sister Karin, a chosen bride. Just when Yuzu has had enough, she unexpectedly captures the heart of Reiya, a dashing ogre from a powerful clan who claims Yuzu as his own.

name: Please Excuse My Younger Brothers
summary: Ito Narita's life is turned upside down when her mother remarries. Moving into a new household, she suddenly becomes the older sister to four unique younger stepbrothers, navigating the chaotic, heartwarming dynamics of her blended family and slowly growing closer to her aloof but kind eldest stepbrother.

name: The World's Strongest Rearguard
summary: After a fatal accident, overworked office worker Arihito Atobe is reborn in the Labyrinth Country as a Seeker with the rare Rearguard class—an all-purpose support role that excels in attack, defense, and healing. Joined by a fierce demi-human mercenary and his former boss, Arihito dives into deadly dungeons and rises through the ranks. The adventure of the strongest support class begins!

previousepisode.name: To the Future of Labyrinth Country

name: Victoria of Many Faces
summary: In an age when spies act behind the scenes in every land, Chloe spends her days successfully carrying out even the most difficult missions due to her unparalleled disguise skills and martial arts abilities. However, after the betrayal of her boss, she suddenly disappears—as Chloe plans to redo her life as the ordinary citizen Victoria in the neighboring kingdom of Ashberry, striving for a "normal" life. However, Victoria's peaceful life is abruptly cut short as she begins to get involved with many people. In this new land, her experiences and abilities from her days as a spy come in far more useful than she ever expected!! On the other hand, the second prince and the pursuer of the organization amongst others take an interest in Victoria's strength, and many shadows close in on the one with all the cards in her hand...!

previousepisode.name: No Matter What Happens in the Future

name: Young Ladies Don't Play Fighting Games
summary: At a prestigious, ultra-refined girls' academy, a scholarship student discovers that her elegant, flawless idol is secretly a ruthless, trash-talking fighting game champion. Bound by a mutual love for competitive gaming—which is strictly forbidden on campus—the two unlikely friends dive into no-holds-barred video game combat.

name: The Naturalist
summary: The Naturalist follows a brilliant but socially estranged biologist who uses the laws of animal behavior to hunt human predators. The twist is that the protagonist has his own dark secrets, and he turns every case into a study of himself.

name: The D Dorm
summary: When Dobby declares his intent to sell the D Dorm, he ends up on a mission to track down the first love of the spirit A Kong in exchange for the right. All the while, he has to deal with the residents trying all sorts of methods to prevent the sale.

name: Ultras: Passion and Death
summary: Through three crimes that forever changed a nation and football fandom, this docuseries explores the violent "ultras" movement in Spain.

name: Dungeon Crawler Carl
summary: In Dungeon Crawler Carl, an alien invasion has wiped out most of humanity and any survivors are forced to fight for their lives on a sadistic intergalactic game show. Sounds bad, right? Now try doing it with bare feet and a stuck-up, self-centered, tiara-wearing talking cat as your partner. Welcome to Dungeon Crawler World: Earth, where the apocalypse will be televised … and Coast Guard vet Carl finds himself stuck with his ex-girlfriend's award-winning show cat, Princess Donut the Queen Anne Chonk, as they try to survive the end of the world, fighting monsters, aliens, an insane A.I. and even other survivors … all for the sake of good TV. Survival is optional. Entertainment is not.

name: Influences
summary: Alex, a 24-year-old young woman, decides to drop her studies to launch, with her best friend Romain, her own influencer agency. Called "Followers Agency", this company manages to gain popularity and becomes a reference for young influencers. However, this success arouses jealousy among his competitors and Alex has to face his rivals, Michaël from "Celebrity Factory" and Sandra, host of the show "Sandra Confidential". Alex's life is turned upside down when she is the victim of a mysterious car accident and falls into a coma. His prognosis is then engaged and the future of "Followers Agencers" is threatened.

name: Kizoku Tantei
summary: A mysterious aristocrat works as a private detective purely for pleasure, bringing an unprecedented twist to the mystery genre: he solves complex cases without ever conducting investigations himself. Instead, he relies entirely on his loyal team of subordinates to do the legwork while he focuses on entertaining the ladies.

name: Cortina De Fumaça
summary: A great open conversation between Aquiribeiro, Bruno Alcantara, and Crônicas de Jorge, where the three friends talk about everyday situations and everything happening on the internet.

name: Starman: Kono Hoshi no Koi
summary: An abandoned single mother of three falls in love with a dying, amnesiac young man. Taking advantage of his memory loss, she names him "Hoshio" and convinces him that he is their father. As they build a life together, Hoshio slowly regains feelings for her while exhibiting mysterious, otherworldly abilities.

previousepisode.name: The Tears That Come After Goodbye

name: Smoking Gun
summary: A sluggish, aloof, yet exceptionally talented private forensic investigator uses cutting-edge science, DNA testing, and data analysis to solve trivial civil cases and uncover conclusive evidence for the disadvantaged, tackling trivial mysteries that the police and the legal system overlook.

name: Heaven's Rock
summary: Heaven's Rock follows the members of a popular rock band and their rival who all die in an unexpected accident. To earn their second chance at life, they must work together and complete various bizarre tasks assigned to them by a shinigami.

name: Room of King
summary: A hilarious game is initiated between four quirky roommates in a luxury Aoyama apartment. They are tasked to compete against one another through a series of eccentric challenges; the ultimate winner earns full, permanent ownership of the coveted home.

previousepisode.name: Announcement of the King and Rebellion of its Residents!? Clear-day-Like Futures of Friends

name: Shinigami no Ballad
summary:
Shinigami no Ballad primarily centers around a young-looking girl named Momo who is a shinigami, or death god. Momo is clad in all white, along with having long white hair, and as a god of death, she leads deceased souls to the other side. She carries with her a large scythe and an ID card which helps to facilitate in her identification as a shinigami; her shinigami ID number is A-100100. Momo is different from other shinigami because she tries to ease the suffering of the people she encounters whether they be living or already dead, such as conversing messages from the dead to the living. She is also known to cry a lot, and she says that she cries for the dead because they no longer can.

Accompanying Momo is a talking black cat familiar named Daniel (Ai Yoshikawa) with a bell around his neck and bat-like wings who helps Momo out. The living frequently hear the ringing of Daniel's bell when Momo and Daniel are nearby. Daniel has a calm character and does not show as much sympathy to humans as Momo, but is still patient with them. In the TV drama, Daniel is portrayed as a young boy rather than a cat. The story follows Momo and Daniel as they interact with the living and usually consists of them changing something sorrowful for the living.

name: Sign
summary: It's been two years since Douji became deaf and lost the purpose in his life One evening when he goes to the club where his big brother works, he meets a dancing boys team and finds out that even if he can't hear what people say he can still feel the music's vibrations and dance Then he decides to join the dancing team and soon discovers a whole new world.

name: Tokujo Kabachi!!
summary: Katsuhiro Tamura and Misuzu Sumiyoshi are employees of a legal document firm. They have very different personalities and don't always get along well, but gradually develop good relations while working together on various legal cases.

name: Night Hero NAOTO
summary: NAOTO has been part of EXILE and Sandaime J Soul Brothers for years, but his job in these groups is a cover for his true job. He is actually a hero that protects society from bad people. He doesn't want to be discovered by the other members, though, because he doesn't want to cause them trouble.

name: Vision: Koroshi ga Mieru Onna
summary: An unpopular fashion model suddenly develops a supernatural ability to see murder scenes before they happen. She teams up with a suspended detective to use her unique "VISION" to solve difficult crimes while unraveling the dark secrets hidden in her own past.

name: Puzzle
summary: Misako Ayukawa, a woman in her 30s, is an English teacher with ironically poor English skills. She values herself over her students and money over love. She displays arrogance in front of her students, but acts pleasantly around everyone else. However, Ayukawa possesses a brilliant mind for solving puzzles. Motivated by the possibility of rewards and treasure, she ends up tackling various cases on the weekends along with 3 of her top students.

name: Jigoku Sensei Nube
summary: Meisuke Nueno is the homeroom teacher of a 2nd grade 3 class in high school. He is referred to as Nube. He sometimes carries himself as an idiot, but he does care about his students a lot. He also has a hidden side. Meisuke Nueno has a demon's hand. He solves monstrous case and fights desperately to save students from monsters.

name: Onna wa Sore wo Yurusanai
summary: Onna wa Sore wo Yurusanai follows a traumatized rookie lawyer who made a devastating mistake in her first trial and a disgraced, fallen elite attorney as they team up to take on difficult, socially conscious case

name: Senryokugai Sōsakan
summary: An eccentric, elite-track rookie policer officer and a martial-arts-trained handsome detective are partnered to solve difficult criminal cases. Shoved aside and frequently scolded by veteran detectives, the duo works together as a team to tackle baffling mysteries and save the day.

name: Kaitō Royale
summary: Kaitō Royale follows a group of amnesic thieves who are brought together by a mysterious woman. Tasked with pulling off dangerous heists, they must cooperate to steal prized treasures and recover their lost memories

name: Pandora
summary: Suzuki, an eccentric researcher at a university hospital, develops a groundbreaking anticancer drug that halts the self-renewal of cancer stem cells. However, his colleagues dismiss his discovery, and he's denied approval for human trials. Desperate, he meets Manami, a terminal cancer patient, and with her help, conducts a clinical trial. But things take an unexpected turn. What will become of Suzuki, Manami, and the new drug? What consequences await as Pandora's box is opened?

name: Triangle
summary: Triangle starts with the murder of a 10-year-old girl in 1984. 15 years later, after the case goes unsolved and passes the statute of limitations, a doctor named Goda Ryoji suddenly quits from his hospital and eventually becomes a detective. In 2008, he meets Sachi, a traveling artist in Paris, and shortly after Goda's return to Japan, he becomes involved in the expired murder case when another detective receives an anonymous phone call.

name: O-PARTS
summary: In the year 2141, terrorists travel back to 2012 to assassinate a key ancestor, prompting the future government to warn 2012 authorities. To stop the plot, a special task force—whose name references "out-of-place artifacts"—is recruited to locate and neutralize the timeline-altering assassins before history is rewritten.

name: Ella, maldita alma
summary: The life of Fermín, a young and attractive priest from the village of La Isleta, becomes complicated when his cousin Isaac and his wife, Ana, move there. He is almost immediately drawn to Ana. When he discovers that she harbors the same feelings, a fierce inner struggle erupts. Ana, for her part, feels an unpayable debt to Isaac for having rescued her from her difficult and tragic past, and she too must confront the nightmare of having to sacrifice her own happiness out of loyalty.

name: 15-sai no Blues
summary: Sanada Kohei is in his third year of junior high school, and is constantly bullied by three classmates, one of which happens to like the same girl that he does. Along with a troubled school life, Kohei doesn't get very good grades and his family life isn't too great either. The only company he keeps is that of flowers, and he has many potted flowers in his room that he takes care of. Kohei has already gone through ten tutors by the time that the drama takes place. Hip-hop singer ZEEBRA plays Shunsaku, his newest tutor. Shunsaku is not the usual kind of tutor; he's a bit perverted and throws Kohei around when he's being difficult. Ultimately, it's Shunsaku's influence that changes Kohei.

name: Face Maker
summary: Kirishima, a skilled plastic surgeon who previously used to work for the US ‘Federal Witness Protection Programme'. His nickname is "Face Maker." Patients come to him seeking to change their lives, and he grants them that wish with a new face. He doesn't take money but asks for his patients' previous faces as a payment. How would you feel if you encountered someone with your former face?

name: Ghost Mama Sousasen
summary: When a cowardly first-grader puts on his late mother's glasses, her ghost—a former passionate police officer—appears to him, prompting the unlikely mother-son duo to team up, solve local crimes, and help restless spirits resolve their earthly regrets before her final farewell.

name: Fallen Angel
summary: Aiba Tsubasa has astounding mathematical powers. He has two younger brothers: Riku, a naive but kind-hearted university student, and Umi, who was born with a weak heart and has no way to be saved except through an organ transplant. In order to help Umi, their mother Takako, a gifted surgeon, had left Tsubasa and Riku who were still very young and sought refuge with a medical research facility. The facility is a shadowy organization which studies people with phenomenal powers in specific areas and repeatedly conducts unethical human experiments in an attempt to create scientifically superior humans. As time goes by, Umi has a successful transplant surgery. Tsubasa and Riku desperately try to protect their younger brother, who has slipped out of the facility to seek their help.

name: Frenemy: Rumble of the Rat
summary: Natsuki Morishita suddenly lost his parents when he was young. After that, he lived at his relative's home, but he wasn't happy living there and he ran away. Natsuki then lived on the streets of the big city. Through a lot of struggles, Natsuki is finally able to open a small store. His childhood friend Wataru Okajima then appears in front of him. Natsuki Morishita and Wataru Okajima get swept up by friendship, betrayal and desires.

name: Fukuie Keibuho no Aisatsu
summary: An unconventional, brilliant assistant inspector ignores hierarchy and her exasperated superiors to solve "perfect murders" using unorthodox methods in a reverse whodunit drama.

name: GM Odore Doctor
summary: A brilliant general medicine doctor, who secretly dreams of becoming a famous dancer, returns to Japan to launch his entertainment career. After being scammed by a fake agency, he stays in the country, taking a part-time job at a run-down clinic to solve medical mysteries while plotting his dance comeback.

name: Freeter, Ie wo Kau
summary: Freeter, Ie wo Kau follows Seiji Take, a 25-year-old with no ambition or savings who quits his job after three months. Following his mother's sudden depression, he takes on manual labor jobs to buy a house, striving to rebuild his family's life and his own self-worth.

previousepisode.name: 新しい家を手に入れた誠治たち武家のその後

name: Beginners!
summary: Beginners! follows a group of eccentric, troubled students who enter a rigorous police academy.

previousepisode.name: Tonight, the finale. Farewell, police academy!

name: Boku to Kanojo no XXX
summary: The story revolves around high school student Akira Uehara, sensitive and demure by nature. Despite that he has a large crush on the most feared and violent girl in school–Nanako Momoi, who seems fragile and cute, until she opens her mouth. One day, Uehara is made to go to Momoi's house where he meets her mad scientist grandfather and unwillingly becomes the test subject for one of his machines. Accidentally, Momoi also gets tangled in the experiment and the two end up switching bodies. To make matters worse Momoi in Uehara's body breaks the machine (which will cost 2mil. yen to fix) as she would like more time in this body thus beginning their world full of debts and troubles.

name: Kara-chan & Shitō-san &,
summary: When a food-loving fashion model and a sauna-obsessed hair stylist with opposite personalities take weekend trips across Japan, their shared journeys through private saunas and gourmet meals become the ultimate remedy for the stresses of modern adult life.

name: Bull Doctor
summary: Tamami Odate, a determined and skilled forensic doctor known as the "Bull Doctor," relentlessly uncovers the hidden truths behind unexplained deaths. As a dedicated single mother, her fierce persistence leads to frequent clashes with passionate detectives and colleagues over conflicting medical interpretations of the cases.

previousepisode.name: An investigation of the cause of death is absolutely impossible a forbidden reckless run! I won't give up!

name: Chance!
summary: Tamaki, a young girl who lives with her motorcycle cop brother, has got a job at a travel agency after months of searching. The most important person in her department is the popular tour conductor Mikio, but her supervisor is the ex-flight attendant Sayori, whose last name happens to be Tamaki. Tamaki's first job is to hand out pocket tissues on the street, and she strikes up an acquaintance with Yajima, another tissue peddler who works for DoCoMo. Drama develops when the two Tamakis fall victim to a mixup in cell phones.

name: Daisuki!!
summary: Daisuki!! follows Yuzu Fukuhara, a 23-year-old woman with an intellectual disability, as she bravely navigates motherhood after the tragic loss of her boyfriend.

name: Fuyu no Sakura
summary: Fuyu no Sakura tells a pure romance story of a gentle, inexperienced glass craftsman in Yamagata who rescues a married woman visiting from Tokyo after a car accident, eventually sparking an unexpected, profound love affair.

name: Death Game Park
summary: Unsuspecting young adults are thrust into a forced, psychological death game for an unknown, sinister purpose. Trapped and unable to call for help, participants use their wits, strength, and instincts to survive deadly challenges. They must navigate the park, outsmart the competition, and find a way to escape alive.

name: Giragira
summary: Giragira depicts the life of a married man Nanase Kohei after he returned to his former job as a male host. He woos the clients with his gentle and caring nature, and soon retrieves his former credit as the ace of the club. However, the transition back for this middle-aged man is not without its challenges. Afraid that his wife will find out about this job, Nanase is also garnering jealousy and displeasure from the younger hosts. Throughout the course of his employment, he demonstrates to others that hosting should not be the vulgar occupation it has become where the entire goal is to make the women frivolously spend money, rather, it is about a human connection that is so often overlooked.

name: Masters of the Universe: Tales from Eternia
summary: The series introduces a new generation of young fans to the iconic world of Masters of the Universe through fast-paced, action-packed mini adventures. Tales from Eternia delivers high-stakes clashes between He-Man, Skeletor, and Eternia's iconic heroes and villains, bringing the timeless conflict between good and evil to life for today's audiences.

name: Stand BI Me
summary: The show focuses on contestants navigating attraction regardless of gender, promising high-stakes drama, secret voting, and strategic romance.

name: Just a bit Espers
summary: The story follows Bunta, who has lost his job and family, as he joins a mysterious company called Nonamare. He is tasked with using small, seemingly trivial supernatural abilities to save the world. A core rule of his employment is that he cannot fall in love. He lives with a woman named Shiki who has lost her memory and believes they are married. The series moves from a comedic tone in the first half to a more serious tone in the second half.

name: Love Actually
summary: Love Actually observes a group of over 30-years-old men and women going through a match-making love journey.

name: Yes, I Do
summary: Yes, I Do is dedicated to showing the audience a real and pure view of love and the most beautiful moments in relationships. In the "Love House," several spaces are created to imitate realistic and high-end love scenes. The eight male and female guests, who are good-looking, clever and good at handling worldly affairs, live in the Love House without a script. They start ordinary and real love stories of urban young people. The shooting of the new-type sweet love variety show promotes the relationships like an idol drama, making the audience feel like watching idol dramas.

name: We are Worse at Love Than Pandas
summary: The series follows Shibata Ichiha, an editor for a publishing company who is struggling in her work and love life. She begins ghostwriting a love advice column for a former model, which leads her to seek advice from Shido Tsukasa, an eccentric associate professor who studies animal courtship behavior. Through the lens of how animals find mates, the characters navigate their own complex relationships, offering insights into human happiness.

name: The Faceless Patient
summary: The Faceless Patient follows a surgeon whose kidnapped wife is held hostage by a blackmailer. He is forced into an impossible medical dilemma: either kill an anonymous, disfigured fugitive patient on the operating table, or his wife dies.

name: Kimi ga Shikei ni Naru Mae ni
summary: Kotaro Sakabe and his friends Rin and Hayato are suddenly transported seven years into the past, where they rescue Shiori Okuma—the prime suspect in the "Serial Teacher Murder Case." As murders continue, the trio must decide: is Shiori a killer or a falsely accused victim?

name: Stove League
summary: A new general manager has to reform a failing baseball team, even if that means making controversial changes.

name: Sirius no Hansho
summary: Sirius no Hansho follows attorney Shota Fujishima as he tackles an impregnable retrial request to overturn the wrongful conviction of a death row inmate for a brutal 25-year-old family murder.

name: P.P.O.I.
summary: P.P.O.I. follows a short, feminine-looking 3rd-year junior high student and his highly popular best friend as they navigate school life, forming a love triangle, dealing with teenage insecurities, and embarking on coming-of-age adventures together.

name: Shirato Osamu no Jikenbo
summary: A timid, kind-hearted, and unemployed university graduate constantly finds himself dragged into dangerous and bizarre crime cases by his opportunistic childhood friend, forcing him to grow as he resolves each incident in this lighthearted mystery-comedy.

name: Entre les lignes
summary:
A bold, immersive journalism series diving into Quebec's hottest, most controversial topics to shine a light on hidden realities, contradictions, and overlooked voices.

Entre les lignes explores intense subjects, including the battle against adult websites, the exploitation of underaged victims, the rise of religious influencers, and the mental health crises among emergency responders.

previousepisode.name: Face aux menaces, la tentation nucléaire

name: TFI Unplugged
summary: With the biggest bands performing exclusive intimate sets and unfiltered conversations with A-list celebrity guests, TFI Unplugged is the place where anything can happen. Chris Evans reinvents your favourite television institution for 2026.

previousepisode.name: Chris Evans, Wayne & Coleen Rooney, Joe Marler, John Goodman & More!

name: Трудный ребёнок
summary:
Former football player Phil is forced to leave professional sports after a serious injury and take a job as a history teacher. However, his career at the school doesn't last long: due to his overly unconventional teaching methods, Phil is fired. To earn money for an expensive operation and get back into football, he starts tutoring with a friend, even agreeing to the most dubious offers.

One day, they get an unusual student — the 13‑year‑old son of the crime boss Lemur. The teenager dreams of following in his father's footsteps and already thinks like a real mafioso. Now Phil not only has to find a way to connect with the difficult child but also help the district police officer's daughter get into MGIMO, despite her strict father's resistance.

name: India's Got Latent
summary:
India's Got Latent is an offbeat comedy talent show where aspiring performers showcase their most unconventional and hidden "latent" talents. Instead of seeking traditional approval, contestants win by proving how self-aware they are, as they must accurately predict the average score the celebrity judges will give them.

Hosted by comedian Samay Raina, the show pivots away from conventional reality TV by emphasizing humor, internet culture, and lighthearted, roaster-style critique from a rotating panel of special guests.

previousepisode.name: EP7 ft. Nawazuddin Siddiqui, Bhuvan Bam, Mukesh Chhabra, Kaustubh Agarwal

name: Subscription Adultery
summary: Subscription Adultery follows an ordinary housewife trapped in an emotionally distant marriage who falls into the dangerous, secretive, and addictive world of an "adultery subscription service" app.

name: DOPE: Narcotics Control Department Special Investigations Unit
summary: Set in a near-future Japan, a new drug dubbed DOPE, is rampant on the streets and shrouded in secrecy. Rookie narcotics officer Saiki, suddenly gets transferred to a special investigation unit whose existence is not known to the public. He meets his new partner Jinnai, his mentor, but the two couldn't be more different - and it shows. Saiki, the serious one, believes in rehabilitating criminals, while Jinnai takes a looser, unconventional approach. Along with their quirky team, the two take on the country's new drug epidemic in this narcotics action-adventure.

name: Foresuto
summary: Kaede Ikushima and Jun Ichinose, a couple living together for nearly a year, appear happy but hide lies from each other. Their seemingly perfect life unravels, leading to a dramatic transformation.

name: Stingers: Undercover Verification Unit
summary: Stingers: Undercover Verification Unit follows an unconventional police team that navigates the legal gray areas of modern crime by carrying out deep undercover operations. Led by an FBI-trained specialist, former criminals and police work together using disguises and psychological manipulation to infiltrate and expose high-stakes syndicates from within

name: Lunch Break Lovers
summary: During her lunch break, game designer Naho Karashima accidentally ruins Haru Amami's vintage clothes with spilled coffee. Unable to repay him, she agrees to make him homemade lunches for 30 days. Their unusual park "dates" slowly turn into something more—until Naho discovers Haru is a creator at a rival company, threatening both their budding connection and their careers.

name: Last-Resort Investigator
summary: Domon Makoto used to work at a forensic science laboratory. He was the ace there and, with his high level of appraisal skills, was known as the Last Appraiser. Due to a case, he quit his job at the forensic science laboratory. Now, he runs his own appraisal office. He works with researcher Takakura Shuko, who is a psychology expert. They receive requests for scientific investigations from the police and judicial officials. The cases are difficult to solve, but they work diligently using a scientific approach.

name: Aces: The ATP No. 1 Club
summary:
Aces: The ATP No. 1 Club is a series that follows the stories, rivalries, sacrifices, and defining moments behind the 29 men who reached the top of men's professional tennis and earned the World No. 1 ranking.

Rather than focusing only on trophies and statistics, the series looks at what it actually took to stay at the top across different eras of the sport. Across four episodes, the series moves through decades of changing playing styles, growing global competition, and the constant pressure that comes with becoming the best player in the world. From the early pioneers of the rankings era through the dominance of the modern legends and into the rise of a new generation, the series explores how each No. 1 left a mark on tennis history.

name: Cheng Huang Lu
summary: At multiple crime scenes where humans turn into demonic beings, the prime suspect caught on camera is the spitting image of the male lead. Armed with an underworld arrest warrant, the female lead detains him to face Heibai Wuchang's judgment. Desperate to prove his innocence, the male lead blackmails the female lead into helping him seek the truth. As they dig deeper, they expose a chilling conspiracy behind the cases and the killer's link to the male lead. What they don't know is that every move they make is part of a mastermind's design...

name: Zhi nian ru ying
summary: The two heroes of the police department, Luo Song and Gao Chuan, encounter a series of events as they investigate the accidental death of their master, Cheng Fenguha. After Cheng Fenghua's passing, Gao Chuan leaves the force but is still obsessed with the truth of the car crash that took his master away. A series of mysteries finally make Luo Song start to believe that there is more to that accident. The duo joins hands once again after many years, but they are unknowingly stepping into a deadly mystery.

name: Masou Kishin Cybuster
summary: In an enviromentally wrecked future Tokyo, a young man named Ken Ando joins an organization called DC. Little does he realize that his fate and that of Earth will be linked to a mysterious mecha from another world.

previousepisode.name: Offense and Defense of La Guias

name: The Night I Got Pregnant by the CEO
Las Culturistas Culture Awards
summary: Celebrating culture's iconic and consequential moments of the year; with more than 100 unique award categories, musical performances and celebrity guests, this show brings culture to life.

name: Taskforce Firewall
summary: A group of individuals becomes cyber protectors against modern digital threats. Cybercrime investigations with field operations, intense combat scenes, and technologically driven missions.

previousepisode.name: Firewall takes on a family of scammers!

name: Seducing My Hockey Rival
summary: After losing both his girlfriend and his curling team, disgraced curler Connor sets out to seduce his ex-girlfriend Ivy's billionaire fiancé, star hockey captain Hunter, to sabotage their engagement, only to find himself genuinely falling in love as manipulation turns into something real.

name: Anonymous
summary: A fictitious department "Finger" established within the Metropolitan Police Department to deal with the social problem of keyboard murder = finger murder, in which the victim commits suicide in the worst case, suffering from slander and burning on the Internet.

name: Can't Write! A Life Without Scenario
Don't Fight With Fools Even When You Get Pissed Off!
Doctor-Y: Surgeon Hideki Kaji
summary: Hideki Kaji, the brilliant yet money-loving "Wizard of Laparoscopy," navigates difficult medical cases, corruption, and bizarre situations. Demoted and working in regional or rural hospitals, this Doctor-X spin-off follows the arrogant surgeon as he balances his greed with his undeniable medical talent.

name: The Wargame
summary:
The Wargame takes viewers beyond the news cycle and behind closed doors into a sealed COBR-style crisis room where real-world senior politicians, military leaders and intelligence chiefs are challenged to confront a high-stakes scenario: a Russian attack on UK soil.

Set six months in the future, this gripping simulation has been developed in conjunction with leading academics, military and defence experts, including Sky News' Security and Defence Editor Deborah Haynes, to replicate the pressure of political decision-making at the highest level.

Rolling news bulletins, social media footage, military and intelligence reports and unexpected interventions throw up a series of minute-by-minute dilemmas, forcing the ‘Cabinet' to grapple with decisions that could affect us all. A provocative stress test on our leaders, our institutions and the country itself, this unmissable event television will prompt us all to engage with our new geopolitical reality.

name: Celebrity Crime Scene
summary: Virtual crime scene recreations help investigators look back into the past to solve mysteries.

name: The Love Lab
summary: An innovative dating experiment reality show that breaks away from the conventions of traditional dating programs. Unfamiliar men and women are placed in extreme and controlled environments, facing unexpected experiments such as blind dates in bed and romances in isolation. Through unpredictable situations, the show dynamically captures the participants' raw, instinctive emotions and the realistic changes in their relationships.

name: PSYREN
summary: One day, high schooler Ageha Yoshina picks up a mysterious "red phone card" left behind in a public telephone booth. A few days later, his childhood friend and classmate, Sakurako Amamiya—who possessed the same card—suddenly vanishes without a trace. In search of her, Ageha finds himself drawn into the rumors surrounding a nationwide string of mysterious disappearances, said to be the work of a secret organization known only as "PSYЯEN." When he accesses the group, a deadly game begins—one that will change his fate forever.

name: BEAT & MOTION
summary: After that fateful night, Tatsuhiko posts a new animation on social media and soon finds that it's gone viral! His favorite musician, Nico, reaches out and asks him to collaborate on a music video for one of her songs. At their first meeting, Tatsuhiko is shocked to discover that he recognizes Nico from the night that changed everything…

name: Le Rouge et le Noir
summary: 1828. The restored monarchy teeters on the brink, a new revolution is brewing. In this turbulent France, Julien Sorel, a poor carpenter's son, is ready to do anything to climb the social ladder. Torn between the Red and the Black, between military ambition and an ecclesiastical career, but also between two women who are complete opposites, he will have to pay the price for his choices.

name: Blazing Him
summary: Zhou Jing'an, a wealthy heir concealing his passion for music, crosses paths with Li Xingyao, a guarded musician raised in an orphanage. Connecting through late-night masked music uploads and tender, hidden gestures, the two navigate past wounds to melt each other's defenses and embark on a journey of love and healing.

name: Les aventures de Nora & Gil
summary: Forensic anthropologist Nora Becker has traveled the world exploring the mysteries of the past. When Nora becomes the guardian of Sam, a 12-year-old girl, she is forced to return to her childhood town, Chambéry. She finds her new purpose when she meets Commander Gil Spinelli, solving complex and fascinating cases.

name: Where the Ink Takes Root
summary: Centered on the intangible cultural heritage of Xuan paper-making, this series follows Xuan Yan, a heir to the craft, and Lin Yiran, a local official who has returned to her hometown. Together in Taohua Town, they navigate the delicate balance between preserving ancient techniques and embracing modern innovation. As they reconcile the clashes between two generations of master craftsmen and break through industrial bottlenecks, they forge a new path for rural revitalization, keeping the thousand-year legacy of Xuan paper alive for generations to come.

name: The Idaho Murders: A College Town Nightmare
summary: In the fall of 2022, four University of Idaho students were found murdered in an off-campus house in the quiet college town of Moscow. As fear spread through the community, investigators faced intense pressure to solve a case marked by few immediate answers. This new documentary unpacks the chilling crime, the investigation that followed, and the lasting impact on a town forever changed.

name: Alliance
summary: Alliance is a competitive captive reality show blending high-stakes strategy, economy and psychological warfare. Sixteen celebrities are split into four teams, battling through physical and mental challenges to earn points - the only currency inside a mysterious HQ run by the System. Face the Ace's power, survive weekly votes, and rebuild alliances every reset.

name: Dai-Tsuiseki Keisihcho SSBC Kyôkôhan-Gakari
summary: The SSBC (Sousa Sien Bunseki Center), also known as the Crime Support and Analysis Center, has a newly established violent crimes department. Their job is to collect and analyze CCTV footage, smartphones, computers, and profile criminals. They provide specialized support for the First Criminal Investigation Division.

name: Possession
summary: Claudia, an ambitious young bi‑racial lawyer, travels to Jamaica to challenge an inheritance claim made by a local man, Cudjoe East, against Oliver Connaught, a wealthy white aristocrat. But the case takes an unsettling turn when Claudia discovers that the disputed estate is the very place that has haunted her nightmares: Hope Hill, the Connaught family's former plantation. As Claudia and Oliver dig deeper, they uncover a disturbing link between the plantation's brutal past and the injustices still shaping the present.

name: Alexander Armstrong Across America
summary: Alexander Armstrong embarks on a journey across the United States to explore how a nation founded on bold ideals has grown into one of the world's most powerful and complex countries. From historic heartlands to modern extremes, this is a country shaped by its past but constantly reinventing itself.

name: The Royals: Uncensored
summary: Katie Nicholl and Jo Elvin host this new show that pulls back the velvet curtain on the world's most famous family with fearless debate, insider analysis and exclusive insights.

name: Caravelle 114
summary: At the height of Brazil's military dictatorship, a flight would change the fate of everyone on board. Among the passengers were a mother, her two young children, and militants from VAR-Palmares with a daring plan: to divert Flight 114 to Cuba. Caravelle 114 reconstructs, in fiction, the events behind the hijacking that defied the Brazilian dictatorship.

name: Fool Night
summary:
A young man, Toshiro Kamiya, lives in poverty and works hard to pay taxes, cover living expenses, and afford medication for his mentally ill mother.

However, the cruel reality around him gradually eats away at his hope.

Living... there isn't a single thing fun about it.

In this dark world full of despair, he chooses the path of the "Spiriflor" — the plants that humans transform into.

Should he continue living as a human being, or cast off his suffering and start a new life as a plant?

Which path would you choose in his situation?

name: The Real Wolf of Wall Street
summary: This three-part documentary reveals the explosive true story that inspired The Wolf of Wall Street.

name: Adventure Time: Bubblegum and Marceline
summary: Princess Bubblegum and Marceline the Vampire Queen journey across the farthest reaches of Ooo, encountering familiar faces and new dangers.
